text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run, because the £400k/year limit was not assessed.

- The model could not align that limit with what it measures: its frame is unspecified, and annual salary spend is calculated from other factors rather than observed on the required scale.
- All four options lack a stated annual-salary-spend value, so the run treated them as leaving salary spend unchanged. The four underlying inputs used are Olumi estimates, not user evidence.
- The comparison is fragile and the goal’s direction was not stated, adding further uncertainty.

To make the budget test meaningful, specify what measurable part of the model the £400k/year limit applies to and state each option’s annual salary spend.
